page.title: Cycles
page.empty_description: A cycle is a project's dated iteration: what a team commits to between two dates, with the people and the agents counted separately.
page.no_project: Pick a project to plan a cycle for.

detail.load_unit_issues: Load is counted in issues: this cycle has no load property.
detail.load_unit_property: Load is counted with this cycle's number property.
detail.burndown_empty: No recorded history yet, so only the ideal line is drawn. The first daily snapshot lands tomorrow.
detail.burndown_approximate: Days before {{date}} are a flat fill: this cycle has no recorded history for them.
detail.close_description: Closing freezes the burndown. Unfinished issues move to the next cycle of this project, or leave every cycle when there is none.
detail.empty_issues_hint: Create a new issue or assign existing ones to this cycle.

form.name: Name
form.capacity_hint: Left empty, no limit is drawn. The two are counted separately.
form.load_property_hint: A number property whose value is one issue's load.
form.rollover: Move unfinished issues to the next cycle when this one ends
form.date_order: The end date must be on or after the start date.
form.capacity_negative: Capacity must be zero or greater.

delete_dialog.title: Delete this cycle?
delete_dialog.description: Its issues stay, planned into no cycle. The burndown history is deleted with it.

picker.label: Cycle
picker.empty: This project has no cycle yet.
picker.needs_project: Give the issue a project first: a cycle plans one project's work.
